responsibility: Defines the C++ front end’s LANG_HOOKS instance and the small set of C++-only hook implementations not shared with Objective-C++. It registers the language identity, DWARF naming, record classification, EH personality, template-argument folding for debug info, enum underlying-type behavior, module-aware preprocessing hooks, and OpenMP declaration-initializer hooks, thereby connecting cp/ semantics to GCC’s generic language-hook interface.
